question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**residence**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence describes crocodiles being present "in many rivers running through the city" of Jakarta.
 
• "**Residence**" (निवास स्थान) refers to the place where someone or something lives or is located.
 
• In this context, it accurately conveys that the rivers were a dwelling or habitat for the crocodiles.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

Complete Passage: *Saltwater crocodiles are also known as estuarine crocodiles, as they (1) **prefer **__to live in mangrove lined rivers. They’re the (2) __**largest **__living reptile, reaching up to seven metres in length: far larger than Indonesia’s famous Komodo dragon, which tops out at three metres. (3) __**Historically**__, crocodiles lived throughout the Indonesian archipelago. We have (4) __**records **__of attacks on humans in Bali from the early 20th century and across much of Java until the 1950s. Even Indonesia’s capital, Jakarta, had crocodile’s (5)__residence__ in many rivers running through the city.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: "relevance"** (प्रासंगिकता) means importance or pertinence. This does not fit the context of a physical presence.
 
• **Option 2: "resistance"** (प्रतिरोध) means the act of opposing or withstanding. This is unrelated to crocodiles living in rivers.
 
• **Option 4: "remembrance"** (स्मरण) refers to the act of remembering or commemorating. This is also unrelated to the crocodiles' habitat.
